title: Spinner Wheel Chess | The REMATCH
summary: Spinner Wheel Chess: The Rematch vs Martin. Same wheel (Move / Capture / Check / Blunder) before every move; this time he plays hyper-aggressively from d4. The very first spin is BLUNDER (forced Bh6). Martin plays sharply, the wheel gives more blunders later ('this spinner wheel is broken'), but enough Move/Check results let him push a pawn through and finish with a queen mate (Qa8#) - series now 1-1.
rules: Spin before each own move: MOVE = free move; CAPTURE = must make a legal capture even if it loses material; CHECK = must give a legal check even if it loses material; BLUNDER = must try to lose at least 3 points of material.
If the demanded move type is impossible, play a normal move.
Strategy note: play aggressively so the game is short and fewer bad spins accumulate.
